<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 28:9">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXVIII</cite> <he>שלש מידות … אבן פ׳ וכ׳</he> there are three qualities of scholars, a hewn stone (seated in the wall), a corner stone &c.; <he>אבן פ׳ שיש לו שתי פיות וכ׳</he> (one versed in Midrash and Halakhah) is a corner stone which has two faces only.—Pl. as ab.
